w3Mentions.name: The Redactor
w3Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — The Redactor.

w3Mentions.name: Gavel
w3Mentions.firstLine: The landlord is stamping the ground. Each stamp lands like a gavel. The tiles it marks start to feel wrong under your feet.

w3Mentions.name: The Focus Group
w3Mentions.firstLine: It followed you. The Focus Group is here.

w3Mentions.name: Spool
w3Mentions.firstLine: Something pads into the clearing — Spool. It's here.

w3Mentions.name: Chorus Line
w3Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — Chorus Line.

w3Mentions.name: The Terms of Service
w3Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — The Terms of Service.

w3Mentions.name: The Callback
w3Mentions.firstLine: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. The Callback is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.

w3Mentions.name: Ad Break
w3Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — Ad Break.

w5Mentions.name: The Cancellation
w5Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — The Cancellation.
firstContext: "OUR STORY BEGINS," says the dark, "at the end."
Travel 2 tiles to ruin.
Something moves out there — The Cancellation.
👁️ Sarah freezes — hand up. "Something's out there. Big. We see it before it sees us — that's our edge. Use it."
💬 Wei: "Smell that? Something's different here."

w5Mentions.name: The Editor
w5Mentions.firstLine: ⚔ THE EDITOR! You're on your own.
firstContext: Night. The treeline is just a sound now. The fire is the whole argument against it.
You don't know what that was. Scissors, and the world getting shorter. Someone at the haven should hear about this.
⚔ THE EDITOR! You're on your own.
Turn-based now. Tap a tile to move — speed is squares. Then act.
📺 SYSTEM: "COMBAT! THE EDITOR! The gamblers lean in. ROUND 1 — FIGHT!"

w5Mentions.name: The Rerun
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📖 Codex: Rerun — locks onto one target — moving won't dodge it. You won't forget this.
firstContext: Armor absorbs 7.
Tiger's attack hits you for 3.
📖 Codex: Rerun — locks onto one target — moving won't dodge it. You won't forget this.
HAYMAKER: a wild, devastating swing. ×2.5. Heavy hands hit harder still (×1.2).
(tiger's hide absorbs 1.)

w5Mentions.name: The Timeslot
w5Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — The Timeslot.
firstContext: This patch is worked out — step to another green patch and forage again.
Travel 1 tile to ruin.
Something moves out there — The Timeslot.
👁️ Sarah freezes — hand up. "Something's out there. Big. We see it before it sees us — that's our edge. Use it."

💛 You hold Mixtape. Hand-labeled: 'FOR THE DRIVE.' No player. The songs are in your head anyway — you hum them when you work, and the work goes faster. Your gifts are not mastered — but they are lived-in, and they have carried you this far. The feast was the weapon.

w5Mentions.name: The Nielsen
w5Mentions.firstLine: ◈ ABILITY — War-table: You read the table's fear the way you read weather. The Nielsen flinches first — you saw it.
firstContext: 📺 SYSTEM: "EVERYONE. SIT. WATCH. The teeth and the weather can WAIT — nothing out there matters until this is done. ...Did I stutter? SIT."
◈ ABILITY — Dreadfield: The room feels you before you speak. Alien-terror starts at 2.
◈ ABILITY — War-table: You read the table's fear the way you read weather. The Nielsen flinches first — you saw it.
◈ ABILITY — Oathbound: Your terror is pledged as a shield: your own people's horror grows half as fast.
◈ ABILITY — Shieldbearer: Spend terror to calm horror — the shield, not the sword. (Offered in the final beat.)

w5Mentions.name: The Finale
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
firstContext: It's settled. The village is calling it "Big Loud." The Codex keeps it.
◈ The System files the name away with visible satisfaction. It has so few words for things that bleed. (+2 integration)
📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
★ IDENTIFIED: Ghost Pipe. White wax-pipe flowers, no green. A parasite on fungus. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
SYSTEM: Identification complete. You are 0.3% less lost.

auditLine: ◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A lesser seat — global standing, waves 1–3 faced (12/7/8), with 2 wave-4 and 2 wave-5 fought, 5 contests survived, 3 crises weathered. The table does not rise. It prices. Ladder — National Standing reached (Fight 3 · Forage 17 · Craft 11 · Talk 15 · Explore 30 → 24 · capped) (+4 feast-bundle bonus)
ledgerLine: The table has read your ledger. More promises broken than kept; the protected outnumber the killed; the food truth was shared. The light road is open.
finalOutcomeLines: ◈ THE ARCHITECT — Daniyar Askarov ascended through doors you built: relay. The galaxy will remember the god's name. The village will remember who built the door. Both are true. Neither is small.

gotAwayLines: It got away. No meat, no trophy — but you're breathing, and now you know its moves.
